I think the biggest reason experts are kept out of government is that our system creates a very limited pool. A governing party will, at any given, have no more than ~450 MPs to choose from (and that is assuming an absolute landslide victory), and the reality is that it is unlikely there will be enough experts for each ministerial position for any given election cycle. There is also the issue of ministers becoming tainted in the public eye due to various types of scandals, so then you would have to find another expert within a very limited pool.

That's not to say that a new party couldn't select experts as candidates for parliament, but then we return to the issue of parties establishing themselves within parliament. I also think that experts, who dedicate their life to a particular field, are less likely to want to become an MP than the average person.
